definitions.gloss: to flutter down; to fall gently; to drift down
definitions.explanation: Describes something light falling slowly and gracefully through the air, as if dancing. Used for things like leaves, petals, snowflakes, and feathers. A poetic, evocative word.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}びら→花びら：13988_hanabira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{舞|ま}い{落|お}ちてきた。
examples.english: Cherry blossom petals came fluttering down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{舞|ま}い{落|お}ちる⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a night when snow was quietly drifting down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{吹|ふ}かれた→吹く：02445_fuku⟧⟦{落|お}ち{葉|ば}→落ち葉：14108_ochiba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{舞|ま}い{落|お}ちて、⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧や⟦{黄色|きいろ}→黄色：02870_kiiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}めて→染める：04253_someru⟧いった。
examples.english: Fallen leaves blown by the wind fluttered down, coloring the ground red and yellow.

notes:
USAGE:
An ichidan (⟦{一段|いちだん}→一段：08951_ichidan⟧) compound verb combining ⟦{舞|ま}う→舞う：04573_mau⟧ (to dance) and ⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ (to fall). The verb evokes a graceful, floating motion. More literary and poetic than simply ⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧. Commonly used in descriptions of nature and seasonal imagery.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{花|はな}びら→花びら：13988_hanabira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{舞|ま}い{落|お}ちる (petals flutter down)
- ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{舞|ま}い{落|お}ちる (snow drifts down)
- ⟦{落|お}ち{葉|ば}→落ち葉：14108_ochiba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{舞|ま}い{落|お}ちる (fallen leaves flutter down)
- {羽|はね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{舞|ま}い{落|お}ちる (a feather flutters down)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{散|ち}る→散る：02075_chiru⟧: to scatter, to fall (of petals) — broader, less poetic
- ⟦{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ→降り注ぐ：07976_furisosogu⟧: to pour down — suggests heavier, more abundant falling
